descriptionHtml:
This Amber Bloom floor length bridesmaid dress is made for an elegant, flattering look. The gentle neckline and flutter sleeves highlight the shoulders and arms, while the defined waist creates a beautiful shape. The full-length skirt flows easily for a romantic finish at weddings and bridal party celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
